title: Climate Change
excerpt: Climate Change refers to long-term shifts in global temperatures and weather patterns, primarily driven by human activities.
content:
Climate Change is one of the most pressing challenges facing humanity. This article synthesizes peer-reviewed research.

## Scientific Consensus

Over 97% of climate scientists agree that human activities are causing global warming through greenhouse gas emissions.

## Impacts

Observed effects include rising sea levels, more frequent extreme weather events, and ecosystem disruptions.

perspectives.label: Scientific Consensus
perspectives.text: Human-caused climate change is unequivocal based on decades of research.

perspectives.label: Policy Perspective
perspectives.text: International cooperation through agreements like Paris Accord is essential.

perspectives.label: Economic View
perspectives.text: Transition costs must be balanced with long-term climate damage prevention.
